Pre Council - November 03, 2026
1.
Call to Order:
Mayor Randall Walker, Presiding Officer, called to order the pre council meeting of the Perry City Council held November 3, 2026.
2.

The above were in attendance for a quorum.

none
4.
Items of Review/Discussion:
4.a
Discussion of November 3, 2026 council meeting agenda.
5a. Welcome Justin Kilgore, Community Development Director.
Mayor Walker will formally welcome Justin Kilgore, Community Development Director, at the Regular Council Meeting.
6a. Downtown Development Authority Appointment - Appointment of Michael Turner.
Ms. Wharton stated that the Downtown Development Authority had a vacancy and that the City followed its standard statement of interest process. She recommended the appointment of Mr. Michael Turner, President of JMA Architecture, noting that his professional experience and expertise would be a valuable asset to the Authority.
8a(1).
Second Reading
of an ordinance to rezone 2.32 acres from R-1, Single-Family Residential District to C-2, General Commercial District. The parcels are located at 993, 995, 1001, 1003 and 1005 Greenwood Drive; Tax Map Parcels 0P0320 078000, 0P0320 077000, 0P0320 056000, 0P0320 064000 and 0P0320 065000.
Ms. Wharton stated this is the rezoning application from the Westfield School for the properties on Greenwood Drive with the added condition that the use would be limited to education purposes.
10a(1). Approve City transferring the contents of the time capsule located in the capstone of the Confederate monument to the Perry Area Historical Society for preservation and archival purposes.
Mr. Smith stated that formally conveying ownership of the artifacts to the Perry Area Historical Society would be beneficial for documentation and recordkeeping purposes. Councilmember Moody inquired about the possibility of placing a new time capsule in the monument’s capstone once reconstruction is complete. Mr. Smith stated that he would discuss the matter with Ms. Loudermilk.
10a(2). Establish Council's 2027 meeting calendar.
Ms. Warren will present at the regular meeting the 2027 meeting calendar for Council’s review and consideration.
10a(3). Approve utilizing the 401(2) forfeiture funds to pay employer match contributions.
Ms. Burdeshaw stated that staff would review the current balance of the forfeiture account, evaluate the available options, and present a staff recommendation to Council for consideration and approval.
